title: 4 Day Chat GPT Upper/Lower Split Forever
author: Edd P.
desc:
Linear Progression
Main lifts
Bench
Squat
Overhead Press
Deadlift

Progress like this:

3×5 lifts

Complete all 3×5 with good technique.
Add 5 lb next week (2.5 lb for OHP if needed).

Deadlift:

Add 5-10 lb each week while progressing well.
Once it becomes difficult, switch to 5 lb jumps.
Secondary compounds

(Row, Incline Bench, Front Squat, RDL)

Use double progression.

Example:

3×8-10

Week 1

8/8/8

Week 2

9/8/8

Week 3

10/9/9

Week 4

10/10/10

Now increase weight 5-10 lb and return to 8s.

Isolation lifts

Use a rep range:

10-15 reps

Once every set reaches 15 reps, increase weight.

Deload

When you miss the prescribed reps on a main lift three sessions in a row:

Reduce that lift by 10%
Build back up using the same progression

You can continue making progress this way for many months before needing more advanced programming.
